scripts.features:
Please stop commenting on my scripts if it's not compliments about the script.
Here is me answering some of YOUR questions..

"is this ai?" -- In the early days of me scripting I had to use ai since was new but now I don't even need it.

"What is the point of this?" -- It is to remove your face... duh.

"why the * would I need to remove my face?" -- No one told you to use it and it's just free FE faceless..
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function removeFace(character)
 
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head then
        local face = head:FindFirstChild("face")
        if face then
            face:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

local function onCharacterAdded(character)
  
    removeFace(character)

    character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if child.Name == "face" then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

if player.Character then
    removeFace(player.Character)
end

scripts.script:
-- Fake Admin Script (LocalScript inside TextBox)

local textbox = script.Parent
local resultLabel = textbox.Parent:WaitForChild("TextLabel")

textbox.PlaceholderText = "Type a command, e.g. :fly"
resultLabel.Text = ""

textbox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
	if enterPressed then
		local command = textbox.Text:lower()
		textbox.Text = ""

		if command == ":fly" then
			resultLabel.Text = "✅ Fly mode enabled!"
		elseif command:match("^:kick") then
			local name = command:sub(7)
			resultLabel.Text = "❌ " .. (name ~= "" and name or "Unknown") .. " has been kicked!"
		elseif command:match("^:speed") then
			local speed = command:sub(8)
			resultLabel.Text = "⚡ Speed set to " .. (speed ~= "" and speed or "100") .. "!"
		else
			resultLabel.Text = "❓ Unknown command."
		end

		-- Clear after 3 seconds
		task.delay(3, function()
			resultLabel.Text = ""
		end)
	end
